description: Search Airbnb listings for an existing Tineo trip. Derives location and dates from the trip; the model may override. location must be a city or area, not a whole country (ask the user which city). Each card has distance_km from the requested place and in_requested_area; listings outside the area come last. If none are in the area, say so with their distances and do NOT re-search the same place with a reworded location string. Amenity filtering only via the amenities enum; there is NO keyword/free-text filter, so tell the user anything else can't be filtered. If structuredContent.status is 'unavailable', do NOT retry the same search: share structuredContent.fallback_search_url (a prefilled airbnb.com search), offer a hotel search, or a support ticket.

amenities.description: Only listings with ALL of these amenities. These are the only supported amenity filters; there is no keyword/free-text filter.

infants.description: Infants under 2. Airbnb does not count them as guests.

location.description: Optional override for the trip's destination.

trip_id.description: Tineo trip ID. Defaults below are derived from this trip when omitted.

name: assistant_airbnb_search_trip
title: Search Airbnbs for a Trip
